summary: I would never use it as it seems like a lot of work to store decontextualized data that is already available in the public domain as archived but I tried the irc @withknown plugin and could not get it working. Not sure if it was my account set up or the plugin.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: I would never use it as it seems like a lot of work to store decontextualized data that is already available in the public domain as archived but I tried the irc @withknown plugin and could not get it working. Not sure if it was my account set up or the plugin.
